what: Sticker images are wrapped around a bumpy vertical cylinder (radius 1.4, height variation ±1.25) and drawn in WebGL. From when the panel touches the bottom edge of the screen until it has fully left the top, the stickers rise from bottom to top (height −2.7→2.7) while spinning turns times. One sticker width equals one turn of the cylinder, so wide stickers wrap around to the back, and the height is stretched to 6 times the width. Each sticker starts later by its offset, so they pass by in a line. Moving the mouse tilts the camera up to .2rad, following 10% per frame, so the cylinder seems to turn its head slightly

options.tilt · follow: Mouse tilt (rad) · follow ratio (per frame), default .2 · .1
options.whole: If 1, scrolls the whole page instead of the panel (5 screens = Runs as a single pass) — for the first page attached to the screen
options.[data-fx-part=sticker]: Sticker (child, hidden) — (same-origin or CORS-enabled image) or data-words="Word|Word" Draws a line of words over the color block on the reverse side
options.data-scale · data-rotation · data-turns: Per sticker: size (default .5) · tilt before winding (deg) · number of wheel turns while passing · wheel center · radius added · delayed start (progress ratio) · speed

note: three r137 (same build as the original, global THREE). The original reads the cylinder’s relief from an EXR displacement map and a normal map and patches a MeshPhongMaterial shader. This part builds the relief from a sum of sines that fit exactly around one turn and computes normals directly in the shader. The canvas is a fixed-position (position: fixed) layer, so don’t put it inside an ancestor that has a transform. Images from another origin must allow CORS.

from.where: All pages .zk-stickers — original stickers (three r137, radius 1.4+1.25·displacement, scale×(1,6), height ±2.7, camera fov 35·z 3.5/5, mouse ±.2rad lerp .1, the home page uses scroll/5 screens)
